about: Width gate (docs/re/windows.md). First rule whose regex matches the string id wins. px = pen origin to the last usable column (line px = sum of VWF advances + 1, tools/lint.py); lines = max lines per string. status: measured (shot named) or guess (lint counts lines held to a guess; measure before trusting).
